competing_explanations: Launch latency dominates the stock boundary.
The 2,752,512 compulsory interface bytes or 4,128,768 logical global-memory bytes dominate.
opportunities.evidence_scope: Source-backed v0.5.13 commit 28b095c, exact Gemma 4 width 21504, c32 decode, H200 SM90; prior flawed-candidate timing is descriptive only.
opportunities.falsifier: Any exact-consumer BF16 output mismatch, nonfinite output, illegal resource usage, or component median not below stock at an admitted M.
opportunities.kill_rule: Kill this decomposition if corrected M32 is not component-positive; do not tune the down GEMM in this project.
opportunities.mechanism: Evaluate GELU(tanh)*up with one BF16 rounding, retain the 43,008-byte BF16 row in shared memory, reduce amax, and emit contiguous E4M3 plus [M,1] FP32 scales directly.
opportunities.next_measurement: On an authorized claimed H200, run exact_consumer_gpu_contract.py at M=1,7,31,32,33,118 with the real layer-0 down weight.
opportunities.observation: Pinned Gemma4MLP has a single-consumer contiguous GeluAndMul -> dynamic per-token E4M3 -> fp8_scaled_mm boundary. The exact c32 stock boundary launches two partial grids and moves 7,569,536 bytes before the GEMM.
opportunities.promotion_rule: Promote to one matched endpoint only after exact-consumer bit identity and positive component timing at every admitted row count.
opportunities.residual_bottleneck_rule: Measure the unchanged down GEMM and full endpoint; do not attribute the analytical boundary bound as realized endpoint gain.

competing_explanations: Activation intermediate rounding changes q codes.
opportunities.evidence_scope: Measured H200 M32 and M2048 against the real down weight; independently reproduced by the CPU bit-level oracle.
opportunities.falsifier: If it matches stock activation, E4M3 codes, and all consumer probes on the exact-width CPU case, the rounding diagnosis is wrong.
opportunities.mechanism: Negative control retains the forbidden extra BF16 rounding between GELU and multiplication.
opportunities.next_measurement: None; the CPU oracle and consumed H200 output both reject it.
opportunities.observation: The prior H200 candidate produced 1.50-1.56% relative-L2 exact-consumer error after rounding GELU to BF16 before multiplying by up.
opportunities.residual_bottleneck_rule: Use only as harness sign discrimination and causal evidence for the corrected source.

competing_explanations: Shared-memory capacity prevents a multi-token CTA.
opportunities.evidence_scope: Measured H200 M2048 prior candidate plus pinned quantizer dispatch; numerical result was invalid but grid/decomposition evidence is usable.
opportunities.falsifier: A physical schedule cannot reduce waves without restoring BF16 HBM traffic or exceeding SM90 shared/register limits.
opportunities.kill_rule: Keep stock fallback above M128 for this project.
opportunities.mechanism: A distinct prefill kernel would assign several rows per CTA without retaining all rows simultaneously, using tiled recomputation or a cooperative two-stage reduction.
opportunities.next_measurement: Analytically enumerate legal multi-token/tiled schedules before any source work; outside the admitted c32 candidate.
opportunities.observation: A one-CTA-per-row fused candidate regressed boundary time at M2048 from 0.138880 ms to 0.213088 ms, while stock quantization switches to eight tokens per CTA.
opportunities.promotion_rule: Open only if a legal schedule preserves the exact one-rounding and q/scale contract with fewer or equal waves than stock.
opportunities.residual_bottleneck_rule: Large-M prefill remains unfused and is not included in the c32 candidate gain.
